// Use "take" to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.

FleetTelemetry
| extend EventTs = todatetime(Timestamp)
| where EventTs >= datetime(2026-11-07T07:00:00Z)
    and EventTs < datetime(2026-11-07T07:15:00Z)
| summarize
    Copies = count(),
    DistinctIngestionTimes = dcount(ingestion_time()),
    FirstIngested = min(ingestion_time()),
    LastIngested = max(ingestion_time())
    by EventTs,
       TripId,
       BusLine,
       StationNumber,
       ScheduleTime,
       PropertiesText = tostring(Properties)
| where Copies > 1
| order by Copies desc

// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
FleetTelemetry
| take 10

FleetTelemetry
| count

// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
FleetTelemetry
| summarize EventCount = count() by BusLine
| order by EventCount desc

FleetTelemetry
| top 20 by Timestamp desc
| project Timestamp, TripId, BusLine, StationNumber, ScheduleTime, Properties

FleetTelemetry
| summarize EventCount = count() by BusLine
| order by EventCount desc
| render columnchart

FleetTelemetry
| extend IngestionTime = ingestion_time()
| summarize
    Copies = count(),
    RowsWithIngestionTime = countif(isnotnull(IngestionTime)),
    DistinctIngestionTimes = dcount(IngestionTime),
    FirstIngested = min(IngestionTime),
    LastIngested = max(IngestionTime)
    by Timestamp, TripId, BusLine, StationNumber,
       ScheduleTime, PropertiesText = tostring(Properties)
| where Copies > 1
| project
    Timestamp,
    TripId,
    Copies,
    RowsWithIngestionTime,
    DistinctIngestionTimes,
    FirstIngested,
    LastIngested
| top 20 by Copies desc

FleetTelemetry
| extend EventTs = todatetime(Timestamp)
| where EventTs == datetime(2026-11-07T07:00:00Z)
    and TripId == "S3278662000"
    and toint(BusLine) == 77
    and toint(StationNumber) == 0
| extend IngestedAt = ingestion_time()
| project
    EventTs,
    TripId,
    BusLine,
    StationNumber,
    ScheduleTime,
    Properties,
    IngestedAt
| order by IngestedAt asc
